summary: Single-layer (cc-only) feature. No cross-layer dependencies — neither inbound nor outbound. The only dependency relationships are intra-cc between the parent orchestrator skill, the 4 execution-side specialists, the re-scoped advisor file, and the existing auditing-shared Bash hook.

depends_on.rationale: This feature touches sub-agent definitions, the parent orchestrator skill, and pipeline-internal state artifacts only. No external surface is invoked or read.

provides_to.rationale: No CI/CD job invokes the execution-phase dispatch loop today. claude-code-action does not run feature-pipeline executions. If a future CI/CD feature were to invoke the pipeline headlessly, it would consume the repaired parent skill — but that future consumer is not in this feature's scope.

intra_layer_dependencies.contract: Parent passes task spec from tasks.json (id, description, type, target_files, satisfies_ac, tests, per_task_skills, revision_context); specialist returns per-task-execution-result.{json,md} pair per Contract 1
Parent passes pointer to per-task-execution-result.json + task spec + modified-files list; specialist returns Contract 1 verdict object (APPROVED|NEEDS_REVISION|STUB_DETECTED|BLOCKER)

Parent passes phase identifier + feature slug + list of phase artifacts + optional scope-deviations input; specialist returns Contract 2 phase-quality-report (5-dimensional verdict: tests, audits, validator, discipline, scope_deviations)

Parent passes phase-quality-report.json (NEEDS_RECONCILIATION verdict) + current cycle counter + feature artifacts pointers; specialist returns quality-reconciliation-log.{json,md} pair containing a dispatch_directives[] array (NEW under option (a) — the reconciler emits routing intent; the parent dispatches the rows)
Parent reads dispatch_directives[] from quality-reconciliation-log.json (per Contract 4 8-row matrix) and re-invokes the named target with revision_context payload

intra_layer_dependencies.lifecycle: Step 15 entry (parent skill reads the advisor file for the canonical state-machine narrative)
intra_layer_dependencies.contract: Read-only reference; advisor file is not dispatched at runtime
Contract 5 payload passed via stdin; script writes one JSONL line to working/feature/<slug>/state-transitions.log; failure is observer-only per D-16

cross_decision_dependencies.rationale: Per synthesis Constraint 5.2: both Agent-removals (execute-orchestrator + execute-finalize-reconciler) SHOULD ship in one commit, with commit message documenting 'FR-5 sweep closure: affected set = 2'.

Per synthesis Constraint 5.1: both D-001 (new Execution Phase Dispatch section) and D-004 (canonical checkpoint.json schema-reference closure at lines 96-128) edit the same file (.claude/skills/recipe-feature-pipeline/SKILL.md). plan-author MUST sequence these coherently — recommended: same phase, dependent tasks (schema closure first to stabilize the documented schema, then dispatch-section addition), OR a single combined task with explicit sub-sections.

Per synthesis Constraint 5.3 / §4: if plan-author's synthetic minimal test feature design authors any new sub-agent file, the plan MUST place an operator-facing session-restart instruction between the authoring task and the test-execution task. Two-session verification is the recommended path; F-7 cannot be mitigated within a single session.

Recommendation in cc-design §15 is option (a) — author the ADR in this feature, because T-001's source-citation work is already done and a follow-on feature would re-incur it. Composer ratifies per FR-5 ADR-authoring authority.

Per synthesis Constraint 5.4 / OI-FRAMER-1: every downstream artifact (Blueprint, ADRs, Plan, test artifacts, finalize-reconciler updates) MUST cite ADR-0017 + ADR-0033 for the 4-cycle cap + symmetric D-12 application. The PRD's FR-3-c phrase 'ADR-0034 symmetric D-12' was a mis-credit, surgically corrected post-Gate-2. This Design subsection has propagated the correction; downstream authors verify their own outputs.

f7_constraint.description: Claude Code harness loads its agent registry at session start and does not hot-reload mid-session. Newly-authored sub-agent files are not invocable in the same session that authored them. Documented by T-001 (n=1, partially_verified).
f7_constraint.this_features_authoring_impact: This feature MODIFIES existing sub-agent files; it does NOT author new ones. Therefore F-7 does NOT block this feature's own implementation phase. However, if plan-author's FR-6 synthetic-test design authors a new sub-agent (e.g., a test-feature-specific specialist), F-7 fires at that point.
f7_constraint.remediation: Two-session verification (synthesis D-002.1). plan-author MUST sequence the synthetic-test authoring tasks and the synthetic-test execution tasks across a session boundary with an explicit operator session-restart instruction.
